mapper.select: SELECT auth.auth_code ,auth.auth_name ,scn.screen_code ,scn.screen_name FROM auth_mgt auth INNER JOIN screen_mst scn ON auth.screen_code = scn.screen_code AND scn.logical_del_flag = '0' WHERE auth.auth_code = #{authCode} AND auth.logical_del_flag = '0';

SELECT user_sys_id AS userSysId ,last_gene_flag AS lastGeneFlag ,user_auth AS userAuth ,todaychef_token AS todaychefToken ,user_login_id AS userLoginId ,user_password AS userPassword ,user_mail AS userMail ,login_status_flag AS loginStatusFlag ,last_login_datetime AS lastLoginDatetime ,stop_flag AS stopFlag ,stop_reason AS stopReason ,temp_flag AS tempFlag FROM member_mgt WHERE user_sys_id = #{userId} AND last_gene_flag = '1' AND logical_del_flag = '0'
SELECT file_idx AS fileIdx FROM file_mgt WHERE logical_del_flag = '0' AND user_sys_id = #{sysId}
